subject: Your first month with Predictify: 47 wins
preview_text: You've been using the app for 28 days. Here's what the data says about your betting evolution.
body_paragraphs: Twenty-eight days ago, you downloaded Predictify: Horse Racing AI. Since then, you've analyzed 142 races, checked 342 predictions, and seen a 67% win rate on your top confidence picks. That's not luck — that's data turning into discipline.

Most punters burn out in week one. They chase losses, ignore form, and blame the horse. You stuck around. You've been through Cheltenham's mud, Royal Ascot's class, and a few Australian rough tracks. The AI has been your silent partner — crunching track conditions, jockey form, and handicap weights while you focus on the bet.

Here's what you might have missed: the Confidence Score filter. Tap any race, then sort by confidence above 80%. Those are the picks where the AI has the most variables aligned — weather, pace, recent speed ratings. Users who use this filter see a 23% higher ROI than those who browse randomly.

Open the app now and check your personal 'Month One' summary under Profile. See which tracks you've mastered and where the AI can sharpen your edge. P.S. — Premium users get unlimited access to those high-confidence filters plus live track tracking. Your 3-day free trial is still waiting if you want to test it.
